reader: Claude Opus 5.5, research reader with source
reason: The image-only reading gave isolated letter groups; with the Vulgate text the minim groups and cut words could be resolved and each line placed in Deuteronomy 32.
sources: Thaddaeus Dereser, Das Lehrgedicht des Moyses an die Israeliten (Bonn: Abshoven, 1788), pp. 8, 9, 12, 14, 15 (Vulgate text of Deut 32:7-11, 16-18, 22-25), page images, Munich BSB bsb11285358
manuscripta.at ID 12460 (Wien, ÖNB, Cod. 3647, host volume)
text:
F-n5r2 - SOURCE-ASSISTED reading (made with the Vulgate text of Deuteronomy 32 in hand). All 28 lines of each face were reread by a research reader on 3x enlargements of the native 648 x 3222 images, 12 October 2026. Not an independent reading. Accuracy not measured.
Conventions: only the letters visible on the strip are given; every line is cut at both sides. (..) = expansion of an abbreviation; ? = uncertain; [ ] = coloured initial or note. Verse numbers after "=" are the proposed place in Deut 32 (Vulgate). Line n lies at about y 190 + (n-1)*108, height about 100 px.
